page.content:
Dagnir (d. FA 460) was an Adan of the First House, one of the XII Bëorings who followed Barahir in Dorthonion. He was killed along with the others at Tarn Aeluin by a force sent by Sauron after being betrayed by Gorlim.

page.overview:
Who is Dagnir?

Dagnir (d. FA 460) was an Adan of the First House, one of the XII Bëorings who followed Barahir in Dorthonion. He was killed along with the others at Tarn Aeluin by a force sent by Sauron after being betrayed by Gorlim.
